en_title: Mass Effect Cast Celebrates N7 Day With Video Asking Fans to Help Save the Franchise
cn_title: 《Mass Effect》演员阵容以视频庆祝N7日，呼吁粉丝帮助拯救该系列
opus_summary: 在EA关闭BioWare、取消《Mass Effect 5》并无限期搁置该系列游戏后，演员和开发者参与录制视频，呼吁拯救《Mass Effect》。粉丝团体We are Mass Effect还发起请愿并投放广告牌，Owlcat Games也分享视频表达对该系列的喜爱。

paragraphs.en: Without BioWare, N7 Day is quieter this year, but that didn't stop the Normandy cast and crew from teaming up for a video message asking fans to help save Mass Effect.
paragraphs.cn: 没有了BioWare，今年的N7日显得更加冷清，但这没有阻止Normandy的演员和工作人员联手录制一段视频，呼吁粉丝帮助拯救《Mass Effect》。

paragraphs.en: EA shuttered BioWare , canceled Mass Effect 5 , and put the gaming side of the franchise on an indefinite hold just weeks before the series' annual November 7 holiday, leaving players just as hurt as they were confused. There's not really any official festivities to enjoy this year, but the developers and actors behind the stories and characters fans love still made sure to get together for a special video message.
paragraphs.cn: 在该系列每年11月7日的节日到来前仅仅几周，EA关闭了BioWare，取消了《Mass Effect 5》，并无限期搁置了该系列的游戏业务，让玩家既困惑又受伤。今年并没有什么官方庆祝活动可供参与，但为粉丝喜爱的故事和角色付出心血的开发者与演员们还是特意聚在一起，录制了一段特别视频。

paragraphs.en: Organized by the unofficial group known as We are Mass Effect, the two-minute video message features appearances from composer Sam Hulick, Jennifer Hale (Commander Shepard/FemShep), Ash Sroka (Tali'Zorah), Keythe Farley (Thane), Kimberly Brooks (Ashley), Mark Meer (Commander Shepard/MaleShep), Steve Blum (Urdnot Grunt), Brandon Keener (Garrus), and many more. One by one, they each call to "Save Mass Effect" in the wake of BioWare's closure, marking what is only the latest shot to garner attention and, hopefully, give the franchise a shot in the arm.
paragraphs.cn: 这段两分钟的视频由名为We are Mass Effect的非官方团体组织制作，出镜者包括作曲家Sam Hulick、Jennifer Hale（Commander Shepard／FemShep）、Ash Sroka（Tali'Zorah）、Keythe Farley（Thane）、Kimberly Brooks（Ashley）、Mark Meer（Commander Shepard／MaleShep）、Steve Blum（Urdnot Grunt）、Brandon Keener（Garrus）等许多人。在BioWare关闭后，他们逐一呼吁「拯救《Mass Effect》」。这只是争取关注的最新一次尝试，也希望能为该系列注入一剂强心针。

paragraphs.en: Today is a very special day for Mass Effect fans.
paragraphs.cn: 今天对《Mass Effect》粉丝来说是非常特别的一天。

paragraphs.en: We've worked incredibly hard to bring together most of the original Mass Effect trilogy's voice cast to share a very important message with you.
paragraphs.cn: 我们付出了极大的努力，将《Mass Effect》原版三部曲的大部分配音演员聚在一起，向大家传达一个非常重要的信息。

paragraphs.en: We need to #SaveMassEffect. https://t.co/FOp0qp4wBI
paragraphs.cn: 我们需要#SaveMassEffect。https://t.co/FOp0qp4wBI

paragraphs.en: "It started feeling like Shepard recruiting the squad in Mass Effect 2!" We are Mass Effect's Mer told IGN when describing the process to make the video. "We were bringing people on board one by one, and Mark was a huge help in making that happen! It almost felt like we were gathering War Assets. And the most surprising thing is that with every video we received, the actors would thank us.
paragraphs.cn: 「这开始让我感觉像是Shepard在《Mass Effect 2》中招募队员！」We are Mass Effect的Mer在向IGN描述视频制作过程时说。「我们一个接一个地邀请大家加入，而Mark为促成这件事帮了大忙！这几乎让人感觉我们在收集战争资产。最令人惊讶的是，每收到一段视频，演员们都会向我们道谢。

paragraphs.en: "We'd get messages saying, 'Thank you for doing this,' or 'Thank you for your work.' We were the ones who felt incredibly grateful to them for taking the time to participate, but they kept turning around and thanking us. That really touched me. Everyone involved, from the people who made these games to the people who brought their characters to life, cares deeply about this universe."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们会收到这样的留言：『谢谢你们做这件事』，或者『谢谢你们的付出』。我们才是无比感激他们抽出时间参与的人，但他们却反过来不断感谢我们。这真的让我很感动。每一位参与者，从制作这些游戏的人，到赋予角色生命的人，都深深关心着这个宇宙。」

paragraphs.en: We are Mass Effect and other Mass Effect fans have been busy the last few weeks. After footage and details for the canceled Mass Effect: Universe appeared online just days after EA brought the franchise to a halt, a petition has launched and gained more than 310,000 signatures . A Canadian politician also started a government petition to save BioWare just last week.
paragraphs.cn: 过去几周，We are Mass Effect和其他《Mass Effect》粉丝一直忙个不停。在EA叫停该系列仅几天后，被取消的《Mass Effect: Universe》的画面和细节出现在网上，随后一项请愿发起，获得了超过310,000个签名。就在上周，一名加拿大政界人士也发起了一项拯救BioWare的政府请愿。

paragraphs.en: As some have called to boycott EA , others have taken their fight straight to the publisher's front door . We are Mass Effect has been a big part of that initiative, with its first and most notable move arriving when it launched a #SaveMassEffect billboard in Times Square . Yesterday, the group drove a mobile billboard around EA headquarters in Redwood City, California . More billboards are live today, including one posted up around the former BioWare offices in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, with another set to appear around The Game Awards next month. Former project director and executive producer Michael Gamble also sent a message to fans for N7 Day.
paragraphs.cn: 一些人呼吁抵制EA，另一些人则直接将抗争带到了这家发行商的门前。We are Mass Effect是这一行动的重要参与者，其第一个也是最引人注目的举动是在Times Square投放了一块#SaveMassEffect广告牌。昨天，该团体驾驶一辆移动广告牌车在加利福尼亚州Redwood City的EA总部周围行驶。今天有更多广告牌亮相，其中一块位于加拿大艾伯塔省埃德蒙顿的BioWare原办公室附近，另一块则计划在下个月的The Game Awards期间出现。前项目总监兼执行制作人Michael Gamble也在N7日向粉丝发出了寄语。

paragraphs.en: Today, our mobile billboard is right outside BioWare's former offices.
paragraphs.cn: 今天，我们的移动广告牌就在BioWare原办公室外面。

paragraphs.en: For 30 years, BioWare gave us unforgettable stories and characters. Today, we're standing up for the people who brought them to life.
paragraphs.cn: 30年来，BioWare为我们带来了难忘的故事和角色。今天，我们为赋予它们生命的人挺身而出。

paragraphs.en: #SaveMassEffect https://t.co/fXa4bemyfE
paragraphs.cn: #SaveMassEffect https://t.co/fXa4bemyfE

paragraphs.en: 🚨 WE'RE KICKING OFF N7 DAY WITH ANOTHER BILLBOARD
paragraphs.cn: 🚨 我们以另一块广告牌开启N7日

paragraphs.en: This time, #SaveMassEffect has made its way to Cardiff, Wales, thanks to the incredible @psykit.
paragraphs.cn: 这一次，多亏了出色的@psykit，#SaveMassEffect来到了威尔士Cardiff。

paragraphs.en: Another amazing initiative from our community, showing that we're not giving up on Mass Effect and BioWare's legacy. https://t.co/4avNpk18jd
paragraphs.cn: 这是我们社区的又一项了不起的行动，表明我们不会放弃《Mass Effect》和BioWare的遗产。https://t.co/4avNpk18jd

paragraphs.en: A member of our community, AngryBaby, has put up #SaveMassEffect billboards in the Frisco and Dallas areas of North Texas.
paragraphs.cn: 我们的社区成员AngryBaby在北得克萨斯州的Frisco和Dallas地区竖起了#SaveMassEffect广告牌。

paragraphs.en: It's incredible to see fans taking the initiative and spreading the movement on their own.
paragraphs.cn: 看到粉丝们主动行动，自发传播这场运动，真是令人惊叹。

paragraphs.en: HOLD THE LINE 🫡 https://t.co/AoJBppCzbV
paragraphs.cn: 坚守阵线 🫡 https://t.co/AoJBppCzbV

paragraphs.en: You all are truly amazing. The love and passion for this…universe…is incredible. Even in worst days, we could always count on you.
paragraphs.cn: 你们所有人都真的很了不起。你们对这个……宇宙的热爱和热情……令人难以置信。即使在最糟糕的日子里，我们也总能依靠你们。

paragraphs.en: "We're still holding on to that hope and fighting for the future of Mass Effect, BioWare, and the people who have dedicated so much of themselves to bringing this universe to life," Mer added. "N7 Day is a reminder of what these games mean to all of us, but also of the people behind them. The impact they've had on this community will never been forgotten, and we will continue celebrating it for as long as we can."
paragraphs.cn: Mer补充道：「我们仍然抱有希望，为《Mass Effect》、BioWare以及那些为赋予这个宇宙生命而投入了如此多心血的人们的未来而奋斗。N7日提醒着我们这些游戏对所有人的意义，也让我们想起它们背后的人。他们对这个社区产生的影响永远不会被遗忘，我们也会尽可能长久地继续庆祝这一切。」

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, as the Mass Effect cast and fans on the ground do their best to celebrate N7 Day, other developers have chimed in to share their love for the series on its saddest holiday so far. Owlcat Games, the team behind the upcoming Mass Effect-inspired RPG The Expanse: Osiris Reborn, shared a video celebrating what BioWare and its work over the decades means to them.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，在《Mass Effect》的演员和现场粉丝尽力庆祝N7日之际，其他开发者也纷纷发声，在这个系列迄今最令人悲伤的节日里分享他们对它的热爱。即将推出的、受《Mass Effect》启发的RPG《苍穹浩瀚: Osiris Reborn》的开发团队Owlcat Games分享了一段视频，庆祝BioWare及其数十年来的作品对他们的意义。

paragraphs.en: "Everybody in Owlcat dreamt about playing Mass Effect 5," studio creative director Alexander Mishulin said. "It's very, very selfish, but we wanted to experience the next chapter in those adventures. Our hearts and minds are with [BioWare], and we really hope they find themselves a new home, different studios that will allow them to make even more worlds, even more experiences, more adventures that we will be amazed at. That will be new beacons for new generations of game developers.
paragraphs.cn: 「Owlcat的每个人都梦想着玩到《Mass Effect 5》，」工作室创意总监Alexander Mishulin说。「这非常、非常自私，但我们想要体验那些冒险的下一篇章。我们的心与思绪都和BioWare在一起，我们真的希望他们能找到新家，找到不同的工作室，让他们创造更多世界、更多体验和更多令我们惊叹的冒险。这些将成为新一代游戏开发者的新灯塔。

paragraphs.en: This #N7Day is a sad one for all Mass Effect fans. So we want to reminisce about what Mass Effect and many other BioWare games meant to us and how they inspired us. https://t.co/HKG5XkLA28
paragraphs.cn: 这个#N7Day对所有《Mass Effect》粉丝来说都是悲伤的一天。因此，我们想回顾《Mass Effect》和许多其他BioWare游戏对我们的意义，以及它们如何启发了我们。https://t.co/HKG5XkLA28

paragraphs.en: "It will be not Mass Effect, but it will be something else, and something beautiful."
paragraphs.cn: 「那不会是《Mass Effect》，但会是别的东西，一些美好的东西。」

paragraphs.en: BioWare's final years were captured on video and will soon be shared in a new documentary . For more, you can check out IGN's interview with one modder who has rebuilt Mass Effect 3's multiplayer . You can also read about how AI is impacting the modding scene .
paragraphs.cn: BioWare最后几年的情况被拍摄了下来，很快将在一部新纪录片中呈现。想了解更多，你可以看看IGN对一位重建了《Mass Effect 3》多人模式的模组制作者的采访。你也可以阅读有关AI如何影响模组制作领域的报道。
